Pricing Document-Preamble 
1. The Pricing Document-Bill of Quantities (BOQ) & Abstract to Bill of Quantities (BOQ) 
shall be read in conjunction with the entire Tender and Contract Document including 
Instructions to Tenderers, General Conditions of Contract (including ‘Contract Data’), 
Special Conditions of Contract, Notice Inviting Tender, Technical Specifications, 
Employer’s Requirements, Scope of work,  Schedule, Attachments, Appendix, Annexure, 
Corrigendum and Addendums. 
2. The quantities given in the Price document - “Bill of Quantities” are estimated 
(provisional). The basis of payment will be the actual quantities of work ordered and 
carried out, as measured by the Contractor and verified by the Engineer and valued at 
the rates in the accepted priced “Price Bid – Summary of Bill of Quantities”. 
3. Tenderer shall quote in the Price Bid (.xls format) sheet only in accordance with the ITT 
clause 10. Tenderer is advised to quote their percentage rate in two decimals for 
Schedule-A. Tenderer has to select option “At Par / Excess / Less” and enter percentage 
rate in figures on estimated cost to Schedule-A, for Schedule-B tenderer is required to 
select percentage option as ‘At Par’ only and for Schedule-C tenderer shall offer Credit 
to BMRCL on Salvage of Materials, in ‘Lump sum’ amount. 
4. The Lump sum amount indicated for Schedule C will be recovered from the running 
account bills proportionately. In case of any variation in Quantities (increase/decrease), 
the value of credit to BMRCL will be increased/decreased according to the value of work 
done from the ‘on account’ bills on pro-rata basis. 
5. The Contractor should note that the credit to BMRCL on salvage materials should be in 
reference to the quoted price and not on the estimate cost put to tender. 
6. The ‘Tender Price’ or ‘Quoted Price’ includes all applicable taxes, duties, cess, royalties, 
and statutory levies as per the laws in force as on last day of the month previous to the 
month of invitation of this tender, except Goods and Services Tax (GST). 
7. The method of measurement of completed work for payment shall be in accordance with 
the requirements as stated in the Technical Specifications and as given in the Price 
document- Bill of Quantities or elsewhere in the tender documents. 
8. The quoted price is for completed and finished items of work and complete in all respects 
complying with the provisions of the Contract. It will be deemed to have included all 
constructional plant, machinery tools, fuel, oil, consumables, electric power, water, 
transportation, disposal of debris at BBMP/GBA identified C&D waste management 
facility (dismantled/demolished material), all leads & lifts, all temporary works & false 
works, fencing, watering, lighting, maintenance, night working and inspection facilities. 
9. The quoted price will be deemed to have included all the safety measures at work sites/ 
casting yard, safety measures for workmen & road users, safety of the public and 
protection of adjoining land & building while working. 
10. The quoted price will be deemed to have included establishment & overhead charges, 
contractor’s profit, supervision, other charges together with all general risks, liabilities 
and obligations set out or implied in the contract and including remedy of any defects 
during the Defect Liability Period.  
11. The quoted price will be deemed to have included accommodations for staff & workmen, 
all insurance costs for labour & works, the payment of all wages, salaries, fees if any, 
charges payable to various departments for obtaining necessary approvals if any.

12. The work is to be executed as per Bill of Quantity description, Technical Specifications, 
specifications of MORTH, KPWD, CPWD, drawings, best engineering practices and/or 
as directed by the Engineer.  
13. Removal of hoardings, interior lighting and interior furniture etc., ACP cladding and 
structural glazing etc., which are existing within the line of cut are incidental to work.  No 
separate payment will be considered for payment. 
14. If it is necessary to maintain any power, water or other utilities during demolition, such 
lines shall be temporarily relocated, as necessary and protected before commencement 
of demolition work.   
15. All such cost involved for temporary relocation/maintenance must be borne by contractor 
and no payment will be made for temporary works. The contractor shall make his own 
arrangements for power requirement for his equipment/machinery. If advised by the 
Consultant/BMRCL, the contractor has to give temporary supports for the building during 
demolition wherever necessary without any extra financial implications to BMRCL. 
16. If advised by the Consultant/BMRCL, the contractor has to give permanent supports like 
wall, columns (Steel, RCC, etc.), including plastering, painting, plumbing, water supply 
and sanitary works, electrical restoration works, etc. to the supported portion of the 
building before or after total/partial demolition, wherever necessary to maintain LOC, for 
which payment will be made as per  accepted rate in BoQ schedule for items available in 
Common SR for the year 2023-24 (Schedule of Rates),  for the execution of such work.  
17. 50% area of Balcony and Canopy if exists will be considered for calculating area for 
payment as per the guide lines for valuation of properties. The area of chejjas or such 
similar coverings/shadows will not be considered for payment.  
18. The demolition and dismantling shall be carried out up to ground and/or up to basement 
level as the case may be including underground water storage structures if any. Refilling 
the low-level areas up to ground level is within the scope of contractor’s work.  
19. The items existing excluding trees within the proposed line of cut have to be dismantled 
and demolished and debris to be transported and disposed. 
20. The total floor area means the summation of total built area of all floors in the buildings 
indicated in Schedule A. 
21. In case some buildings are deleted or added in BOQ, the rates per sqm for that 
deletion/addition will be same as given above. For payment purpose, the %age quoted 
and accepted in the Summary Cost will be used for the above rate.
